_meta: Each fix from AUDIT.md (0.5.0) and from this round, mapped to the test(s) that prove it. scripts/verify-fixes.js runs the whole suite and checks every listed test passed.

fixes.fix: owner granted only from the server console
tests: only the owner can extend or cancel; extension uses calendar months

fixes.fix: non-object JSON rejected
tests: SEC-2: non-object JSON bodies are rejected with 400, never 500

fixes.fix: password length bounded
tests: SEC-3: password length is bounded

fixes.fix: in-memory throttle bounded
tests: SEC-4: throttle map is bounded and drops empty keys

fixes.fix: expired sessions purged
tests: retention: expired sessions, old audit rows and old invites are purged

fixes.fix: legacy accounts get a trial
tests: SEC-6: legacy accounts get a trial on upgrade instead of being locked

fixes.fix: production config check, HSTS, file permissions
tests: production config: refuses unsafe settings
HSTS is sent only when secure cookies (HTTPS) are configured
backup: consistent copy of a live database, verified, owner-only permissions, rotation

fixes.fix: staff views are read-only
tests: SEC-8: staff viewing an athlete does not write into the athlete history

fixes.fix: registration throttled
tests: SEC-10: registration is throttled per address

fixes.fix: trust levels, estimate labelling, reviewed-only mode, review script
tests: every output built from unreviewed values is labelled as an estimate
reviewed-only mode refuses to build a plan while reviewed data is insufficient
review script: validates every row and writes nothing on any error
integrity: a food counts as reviewed only with reviewer, source and date

fixes.fix: menstrual question required for female athletes
tests: SCI-1: for a female athlete the menstrual question cannot be skipped

fixes.fix: measured RMR plausibility
tests: SCI-2: measured RMR must be plausible for the body (hand-computed Mifflin)

fixes.fix: start date window
tests: SCI-3: start date window is enforced on the server

fixes.fix: hydration dates real and not future
tests: SCI-4: hydration dates must be real and not in the future

fixes.fix: no future check-ins; servings range
tests: SCI-5 / SCI-6: no check-ins for future weeks; servings out of range are rejected, not silently changed
SCI-7: 405 for a wrong method; 404 when deleting something that does not exist

fixes.fix: full export, account deletion, retention
tests: export: everything about the user, no secrets, and still available when locked
deletion needs the confirmation word and the password; then all personal rows are gone
an academy is never left without an admin; solo academies are removed; creator is reassigned

fixes.fix: backup / restore
tests: restore: refuses without confirmation or with a bad file; keeps the previous database

fixes.fix: delivery separate from preferences
tests: saving preferences does not send anything; validation rejects bad values
delivery: due reminders reach the in-app inbox once (idempotent), respecting time and data
external forwarding only for opted-in users; failures are retried at most 3 times

fixes.fix: dietitian verification + separate PRO subscription
tests: consent alone is not enough: unverified dietitian sees the coach view
the two subscriptions stay separate

fixes.fix: browser-shared modules
tests: modules shared with the browser demo use no Node built-ins and no unguarded process.env

fixes.fix: food review worksheet + FDC comparison (no approvals)
tests: every review comes from a named person through scripts/review-foods.js (reviewer, date, source, previous values kept)
worksheet: one pending row per food, nothing modified
FDC comparison flags differences, wrong identifiers and missing data (synthetic fixture)
an unexpected download format is rejected, not silently mis-read

fixes.fix: science review file in sync with code
tests: documented values equal the values in the code
season caps are defined once (rate.PHASE_CAP equals the season table)
every rule says its basis; references point to the registry; a review is claimed only with reviewer, date and decision

fixes.fix: screening questionnaire for review in sync
tests: every screening field is in the review document
every flag code in the code is in the review document
document states it is not medically approved

fixes.fix: origin check
tests: CSRF: cross-site state changes are refused; same-origin and reads are allowed

fixes.fix: password reset / e-mail verification tokens
tests: password reset: one-time, short-lived, newest link only, logs out everywhere, no account enumeration
e-mail verification: token sets the flag once; without a gateway nothing is sent

fixes.fix: shared persistent throttle
tests: throttle is shared between processes using the same database and survives a restart

fixes.fix: encryption attestation & origins config
tests: config: disk-encryption is an attestation warning, origins must be https hosts

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: weight loss for 12–17 only with linked-guardian consent; deficit ≤15%
tests: age limits: 11 rejected, 12 accepted
without guardian consent a minor stays at maintenance
family invite → parent links → consent lifts the hold; revoke or unlink restores it
other red flags still hold a minor even with guardian consent
minor limits: deficit ≤15% of needs (app rule R-W6)

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: fencing, modern pentathlon, triathlon
tests: validation: new sports and their disciplines
energy: net-MET exercise energy (hand-computed) and estimate warnings
guidance: sport and discipline text is added, numbers unchanged by discipline

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: read-only share links (e-mail / WhatsApp / Telegram)
tests: share needs consent, a valid duration and a plan
link works without login, hides private data, is noindex, and can be revoked
expired links and links of an inactive subscription stop working
deleting the account removes its links

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: sign in with Google (OIDC + PKCE, id_token verified)
tests: new Google user: account created, e-mail verified, trial started, no usable password, PKCE verifier sent
rejected tokens: wrong audience, issuer, nonce, signature, expiry, unverified e-mail, tampered state
unit: alg "none" and unknown kid are rejected
existing password account with an UNVERIFIED e-mail: password and sessions cancelled, then linked
existing account with a VERIFIED e-mail keeps its password when Google is linked
config: Google needs both credentials and an https public URL in production

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: household — same dishes for shared meals, personal grams
tests: household: create, invite, join; one membership per person; bad codes rejected
shared breakfast: same dish and sides for both brothers, grams from each one’s own targets
an allergy wins over the household dish
leaving: the house passes to the next member; deleting the last account removes it

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: comparison with official USDA files, no value changed
tests: USDA subsets only hold the app’s claimed NDB numbers, with the source of every value
comparison flags real differences and never approves a food

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: non-athlete mode, name in PDF, one-week calorie override
tests: non-athlete: no sport, discipline, season phase or competition; season change refused
PDF: shows the person’s name and no "unreviewed estimate" banner
override: safety minimum, at most 7 days, plan follows it, then targets come back
override while the plan is held: no deficit below maintenance

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: adult self-responsibility waiver with non-waivable cases
tests: engine: waiver lifts missing screening and clearable red flags for adults only
API: every acknowledgement required; deficit applies; withdraw restores maintenance
API: refused for under 18
accepting or withdrawing rebuilds an existing week plan so meals follow the new calories
with the acknowledgement an adult may choose up to 0.9 kg/week (reviewer decision); never minors or pregnancy

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: downloadable nutrition PDF (server Chromium or in-browser)
tests: pdf writer: valid header, one page object per image, correct xref offsets
page cuts: forced breaks, no cut inside a block that fits a page, every pixel on exactly one page
server PDF: 501 with a clear message when Chromium is not configured
server PDF: real A4 PDF download with the signature on the pages (needs a Chromium binary)

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: NNI 2006 transcription + comparison, no food value changed
tests: NNI transcription: every row has its page and is internally consistent
NNI rows point at real app foods and each app food appears once
comparison: carbohydrate adds NNI fibre back; nothing is approved; foods.json untouched

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: reviewer decisions 2026-10-22 (deficit ≤35%, referral from 3 REDS signs, waiver up to 0.9 kg/week, documented values match code)
tests: severe deficit is capped at 35 % of TDEE (reviewer decision 2026-10-22) and flagged
screening: holds and referral reasons
with the acknowledgement an adult may choose up to 0.9 kg/week (reviewer decision); never minors or pregnancy
documented values equal the values in the code

fixes.fix: 0.7.0: gain goals (muscle_gain, weight_gain, fat_gain) — app rules R-G1…R-G6 approved by the reviewer 2026-10-22
tests: validation: gain goals need a higher target; loss goals still need a lower one
plan: surplus above TDEE, within the goal cap, macros add up, protein and fat per rule
plan: minors and in-season athletes gain more slowly; custom rate above the cap is refused
timeline, progress and target date work upward
adaptive: slower gain → proposal to add energy; much faster → reduce; never on thin data
screening: a surplus plan is not held for REDS-type signs, but eating, chronic and pregnancy still hold
API: a gain goal gives surplus targets after screening; surplus applies once screening is done

fixes.fix: audit 2026-10-22: a free meal's TARGET was added to the day total as if it were food; totals now = calculated food only, allowance kept apart
tests: audit D1: meal = sum of items, day = sum of meals, week = sum of days, free-meal allowance kept apart (112 plans)
free meal on its date; its allowance is a separate budget, never counted as food

fixes.fix: audit 2026-10-22: reports state the real data sources, RMR and TDEE separately, the calculation version, review state and page numbers
tests: nutrition file: RMR and TDEE separate, version, real sources (no stale SR-Legacy-only claim), page numbers, free-meal budget

fixes.fix: audit 2026-10-22: logged intake separate from planned food and targets; incomplete days stay incomplete
tests: engine: logged entry = planned items × fraction; free meal is not quantified; nothing comes from targets
API: log, change, clear; week totals sum entries; incomplete days stay incomplete; future and foreign days refused

fixes.fix: audit 2026-10-22: dietitian plan review (approve / revise / reject / refer), server-side clinical-level only, bound to current targets, audited
tests: plan review: only a verified, subscribed dietitian with consent; bound to the current targets; audited

fixes.fix: audit 2026-10-22: calcVersion + methods on every plan, TDEE scenario range, macro energy check, Mifflin by hand
tests: Mifflin-St Jeor by hand: male 80 kg, 180 cm, 30 y = 1780; female same = 1614 (predicted, not measured)
plan carries calcVersion and methods; TDEE range brackets the estimate
macro annotations: 4/4/9 energy, gap within rounding, g/kg and % of energy

fixes.fix: 0.8.0: offline Android app bundle and shell (no external URLs, strict CSP, no auto cloud backup, tests gate the APK build)
tests: mobile bundle: offline (no external URLs), strict CSP, mobile mode on, no demo seed or subscription lock
android shell: no automatic cloud backup, file sharing only from the app cache, workflow tests before building
